rules.description: Strictly enforce historical deletion average threshold of 0.1%
Verify MaxDate is within allowable 3-year publication lag for all StatVars except rare historical exceptions

params.query: SELECT StatVar, MaxDate FROM stats WHERE StatVar NOT IN ('Count_MortalityEvent_ChronicGlomerulonephritisNephritisAndNephritisNotSpecifiedAsAcuteOrChronicAndRenalSclerosisUnspecified', 'Count_MortalityEvent_AccidentalDischargeOfFirearms')
